hints.title: Single Direction Road Mutual Exclusion
hints.text: Cars arrive randomly at an intersection connecting Road 1 and Road 2. Cars traveling on the current green road may proceed immediately. What synchronization primitive protects light switching?

hints.title: Active Green Road State Guard
hints.text: Maintain an integer variable recording the currently active green road. Protect light checks and signal changes with a mutual exclusion lock.

hints.title: Conditional Signal Switch and Car Passage
hints.text: When a car arrives from roadId, acquire the lock. If roadId differs from current green road, invoke changeGreen() and update the state variable. Then invoke crossCar() and release the lock.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import threading

class TrafficLight:
    def __init__(self):
        self.green_road = 1
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def carArrived(
        self,
        carId: int,
        roadId: int,
        direction: int,
        changeGreen: 'Callable[[], None]',
        crossCar: 'Callable[[], None]'
    ) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            if self.green_road != roadId:
                self.green_road = roadId
                changeGreen()
            crossCar()
```

complexity.notes: Each car arrival processes light state checking and crossing within a constant time critical section.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unsynchronized direction changes cause multiple cars from intersecting roads to enter simultaneously.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Requires only a single lock and integer state variable.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simple serializing lock ensuring thread-safe road direction transitions.
